name: Calendar, Month
description: Month-grid view with tunable dashboard title/day-number/event text sizing, cell spacing, and a location toggle for text-display mode. Each feed's colour drives the bar / dot / stripe colour.

cell_options.name: feeds_filter
cell_options.label: Calendars
cell_options.help: Feed IDs, separated by commas. Blank shows every enabled calendar.

cell_options.name: rolling_weeks
cell_options.label: Window
cell_options.help: Month shows the calendar month. A number of weeks starts at the week containing today and rolls forward week by week.

choices.label: Title text with feed colour bar

cell_options.name: show_location
cell_options.label: Event locations
cell_options.help: Appends '· location' after each event title. Off by default since month cells are the tightest on space of any calendar widget.

cell_options.name: event_title_lines
cell_options.label: Event title lines
cell_options.help: How many lines an event title may wrap onto before it is cut. 1 = single line with an ellipsis.

cell_options.name: show_week_start
cell_options.label: Week starts label
cell_options.help: Off by default: the weekday column headers already show which day the week starts on. Worth turning on with a minimal or single-letter weekday style, where it is less obvious.

cell_options.name: title_scale
cell_options.label: Title size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the 'MONTH YYYY' header row at the top of the widget.

cell_options.name: header_scale
cell_options.label: Day number size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on each cell's day-number badge.

cell_options.name: event_title_scale
cell_options.label: Event text size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on event text in text-display mode (and the '+N' overflow chip).

cell_options.name: event_row_padding_em
cell_options.label: Cell spacing
cell_options.help: Extra padding added inside each day cell, on top of the default. 0 = default.
